module autovcoder_087896 #(
    parameter DW    = 10,            //memory width (default size 104)
    parameter DEPTH = 8,             //memory depth (default size 32)
    parameter PROJ  = "",            //project name
    parameter MCW   = 8,             //repair/config vector width
    parameter AW    = $clog2(DEPTH)  // address bus width
) (  // Memory interface (dual port)
    input           wr_clk,   //write clock
    input           wr_en,    //write enable
    input  [DW-1:0] wr_wem,   //per bit write enable
    input  [AW-1:0] wr_addr,  //write address
    input  [DW-1:0] wr_din,   //write data
    input           rd_clk,   //read clock
    input           rd_en,    //read enable
    input  [AW-1:0] rd_addr,  //read address
    output [DW-1:0] rd_dout
);
  //,//read output data
  // Power/repair (ASICs)
  // input 	    shutdown, // shutdown signal from always on domain   
  // input [MCW-1:0] memconfig, // generic memory config

  // input 	    bist_we, // write enable global signal

  // input [AW-1:0]  bist_addr, // address
  // input [DW-1:0]  bist_din  // data input

  oh_memory_ram #(
      .DW(DW),
      .DEPTH(DEPTH)
  ) memory_dp (  //read port
      .rd_dout(rd_dout[DW-1:0]),
      .rd_clk (rd_clk),
      .rd_en  (rd_en),
      .rd_addr(rd_addr[AW-1:0]),
      //write port
      .wr_en  (wr_en),
      .wr_clk (wr_clk),
      .wr_addr(wr_addr[AW-1:0]),
      .wr_wem (wr_wem[DW-1:0]),
      .wr_din (wr_din[DW-1:0])
  );



endmodule
